mechanism_and_prior.policy: atestiguada/literature — citation VERIFIED via EuropePMC + raw-cached (§7.9); specific numeric constants NOT fabricated (§7).

verified_citation.title: Differential diffusivity of Nodal and Lefty underlies a reaction-diffusion patterning system.

mechanism_and_prior.mechanism_from_abstract_RETRIEVED: Measured (Muller 2012, from the authoritative abstract): Nodals have SHORTER range than Lefty; Nodal & Lefty have SIMILAR clearance kinetics -> the range difference is driven by DIFFERENTIAL DIFFUSIVITY, NOT differential clearance. (FRAP: Lefty diffuses faster than Nodal.)
mechanism_and_prior.fit_constraint: D(Lefty) > D(Nodal); clearance k similar across the two -> the reaction-diffusion prior is a fast long-range inhibitor (Lefty) + slow short-range activator (Nodal).
mechanism_and_prior.approach_RESOLVES_the_gap: Per the acquisition_trigger ("fit against the ZESTA atlas"): fit D/k to OUR measured ZESTA gradients (Part 1) using Muller 2012 differential-diffusivity as the STRUCTURAL PRIOR + qualitative constraint. This avoids importing another assay constants and is the methodologically-correct "fit against ZESTA".
gap_flags: Muller 2012 specific numeric D values are behind Science access (not OA via EuropePMC; PMC3525670 fullTextXML 404; BioModels 0 hits) — NOT fabricated. Only needed as an optional sanity prior; the operative constants are FIT to ZESTA.

bngl_topology.note: Rule TOPOLOGY (species + reactions) — a SPEC, not a fitted model. The .bngl generation + fit is MITAD_B's side (A/B contract: A grounds, B generates). Handed off as input.
rules: pSmad2 -> pSmad2 + Lefty             # Nodal-induced Lefty feedback (matches measured lft1 rise)
Lefty + Oep -> Lefty:Oep            # competitive inhibition of Nodal reception (fast diffuser)
Chordin + BMP -> Chordin:BMP         # BMP sequestration (matches measured chrd ramp)
bngl_topology.falsifier: a Lefty perturbation (MO/mutant) does not move the Nodal-domain boundary as the fitted model predicts (per acquisition_trigger candidate_falsifier).
